info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks JCESR Electrolyte Genome API

params.name: nelements_max
params.description: Maximum value for the number of elements.

params.name: nelements_min
params.description: Minimum value for the number of elements.

params.name: EA_max
params.description: Maximum value for the electron affinity in eV.

params.name: EA_min
params.description: Minimum value for the electron affinity in eV.

params.name: IE_max
params.description: Maximum value for the ionization energy in eV.

params.name: IE_min
params.description: Minimum value for the ionization energy in eV.

params.name: charge_max
params.description: Maximum value for the charge in +e.

params.name: charge_min
params.description: Minimum value for the charge in +e.

params.name: pointgroup
params.description: Point of the molecule in Schoenflies notation.

params.name: smiles
params.description: The simplified molecular input line-entry system (SMILES)             representation of the molecule.

params.name: elements
params.description: Query by elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: formula
params.description: Chemical formula of the molecule. A comma-separated list of formulas is also accepted.

params.name: task_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of task_ids to query on

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _sort_fields
params.description: Comma delimited fields to sort with. Prefixing '-' to a field will force a sort in descending order.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from MoleculesDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `elements` `nelements` `EA` `IE` `charge` `pointgroup` `smiles` `task_id` `molecule` `formula_pretty` `svg`

params.name: _all_fields
params.description: Include all fields.
